# Claim-Bearing Term Fixture

The contract clause requires a robust parser, and the word is the acceptance bar the vendor signed: a parser that keeps working on malformed input rather than one that reads well.

Replacing it with `reliable` or `solid` drops the malformed-input requirement, so the sentence would promise less than the clause does.
